tts_setup_info: This assistant bundles the automatic VibeVoice setup. It checks the status, skips FFmpeg when it is already available, downloads the wrapper, and sets it up as far as possible. Important: the actual model download only begins once the wrapper can run successfully. According to the wrapper README, this path expects Python 3.13, ffmpeg, and on the first real start roughly 2 GB of models plus about 22 MB of voices. For an instant offline fallback, the settings also offer 'windows_sapi' with built-in Windows voices.
